slides.texte_overlay:
1. Ask your father about his life
before you were born.
You'll understand him
and yourself.

2. Your reputation walks into rooms
before you do.
Build it on purpose.

3. Train for the man you'll be at 50,
not for the mirror at 25.
Strength you keep beats
looks you lose.

4. Some friends will drift away
without a fight.
It's nobody's fault.
Let them go with respect.

5. Learn to be alone without your phone.
A man who can't sit with himself
will follow anyone who distracts him.

6. The men you envy are carrying
things you can't see.
Run your own race.

7. Learn to cook, clean, and fix.
Independence isn't money.
It's being able to take care
of yourself.

8. Read more than you watch.
The ideas you take in now
become the man you are later.

9. Start learning every day,
now. Not "one day".
Five minutes compounds
into a different man.
slides.texte_sophia:
9. Start learning every day,
now. I wish I'd started earlier.
Now it's 5 minutes a day
on the Sophia app.
